reference.purpose: accepted full-footprint top plan geometry + target source and front identity

prompt: Generate a single pixel-art orthographic TOP view looking perfectly straight down onto the exact parade bleachers. Copy the accepted geometry reference footprint: preserve the same square-ish full-depth plan, same outer post positions, same number and positions of horizontal dark seat/tread rows with gold front trim, and same cream/gold side rails. Make only this change: the two red pennants hang vertically from the FRONT face and are occluded from above. Remove their broad red faces and gold emblems entirely from the TOP surface. At the near/front edge, show only two very thin red hem lines if visible, not wide banners. Do not shorten the plan or widen it; match the reference XY footprint exactly. Do not show vertical riser/front faces. Top-down horizontal seat/tread surfaces only. Transparent background outside sprite, centered, crisp pixel-art clusters.
